name: Benchmark Retinal Image Database for Diabetic Retinopathy
description: A curated retinal fundus image dataset with labels/annotations for diabetic retinopathy severity and related lesions to evaluate DR analysis algorithms.
typical_sota_score: 90–98% (task-dependent; reported as AUC/accuracy/F1 in different works)
reputation: Widely used in medical imaging research for benchmarking diabetic retinopathy analysis methods, though multiple variants exist.
notes: Common issues: label noise and inter-grader variability, class imbalance (severe cases underrepresented), potential patient/picture overlap across splits; medical dataset requiring ethical considerations; not an LLM benchmark.
